# One template per block; {k} is replaced by each separator of words.txt (\s space, \t tab, \n line break).
=== endif bas
If a Then
End{k}If
=== endsub bas
Sub P()
End{k}Sub
=== exitsub bas
Sub P()
Exit{k}Sub
End Sub
=== exitdo bas
Sub P()
Do
Exit{k}Do
Loop
End Sub
=== onerror bas
Sub P()
On{k}Error{k}Resume{k}Next
End Sub
=== ongoto bas
Sub P()
On Error{k}GoTo{k}0
End Sub
=== goto bas
Sub P()
Go{k}To L
L:
End Sub
=== gosub bas
Sub P()
Go{k}Sub L
L:
End Sub
=== lineinput bas
Sub P()
Line{k}Input{k}#1, a
End Sub
=== dowhile bas
Sub P()
Do{k}While a
Loop
End Sub
=== selectcase bas
Sub P()
Select{k}Case a
Case 1
End Select
End Sub
=== endselect bas
Sub P()
Select Case a
Case 1
End{k}Select
End Sub
=== endwith bas
Sub P()
With o
End{k}With
End Sub
=== foreach bas
Sub P()
For{k}Each x In c
Next
End Sub
=== propget bas
Property{k}Get P() As Long
End Property
=== endprop bas
Property Get P() As Long
End{k}Property
=== optexp bas
Option{k}Explicit
=== optcmp bas
Option{k}Compare{k}Text
=== declfn bas
Declare{k}Function f Lib "k" () As Long
=== dimas bas
Dim a{k}As{k}Long
=== rediml bas
Sub P()
ReDim{k}Preserve a(1)
End Sub
=== openfor bas
Sub P()
Open "f"{k}For{k}Input{k}As{k}#1
End Sub
=== typeend bas
Type T
a As Long
End{k}Type
=== enumend bas
Enum E
A
End{k}Enum
=== elseif bas
Sub P()
If a Then
Else{k}If b Then
End If
End If
End Sub
=== endif1 bas
Sub P()
If a Then
EndIf
End Sub
=== setnew bas
Sub P()
Set a ={k}New C
End Sub
=== callp bas
Sub P()
Call{k}f(1)
End Sub
=== assign bas
Sub P()
a{k}={k}1
End Sub
=== expr bas
Sub P()
x = a{k}+{k}b
End Sub
=== member bas
Sub P(o As Object)
x = o{k}.p
End Sub
=== memberbang bas
Sub P(o As Object)
x = o{k}!p
End Sub
=== callargs bas
Sub P()
x = f{k}(1)
End Sub
=== stmtargs bas
Sub P()
f{k}1, 2
End Sub
=== compare bas
Sub P()
x = a <{k}> b
End Sub
=== compare2 bas
Sub P()
x = a ={k}> b
End Sub
=== named bas
Sub P()
f a:{k}=1
End Sub
